description: Metric contract registry for keld-benches. Source of truth for WHICH metrics exist, their units, oracles, budgets, and sample policy. Encodes the named contracts of Keld docs/research/49-falsifiable-bench-and-test-ladder.md (falsifiable scoreboard §1, cache-state classes §3.1, sample policy §5). Adding a metric = adding one entry here; the result document shape (schema/result.v1.schema.json) does not change. Correctness/security gates precede performance: a faster run that fails a required gate is invalid.

cache_states.boot-cold: First launch after reboot / clean VM snapshot; one sample per boot.
cache_states.fresh-process: Complete prior process coalition removed; fresh profile; OS caches uncontrolled.
cache_states.warm-cache: One unscored priming launch, then fresh processes using the same profile.
cache_states.renderer-warm: Navigation / second window in an existing process; separate metric class.

regression_rule.fail: lower 95% CI of candidate/baseline ratio exceeds threshold
regression_rule.pass: upper 95% CI is at or below threshold
regression_rule.inconclusive: interval crosses threshold; rerun or waive in writing

metrics.oracle: Bad frame/token -> typed host error or close; no token bytes returned; listener/host survives.
Authenticated denied call emits KELD-GUARD*; handler count remains zero; OS side effect absent.
Crash revokes old generation before a new endpoint/token; stale token fails.
Parent clock: spawn request -> child entry -> authenticated HELLO -> first valid app reply.
Real mapped/key/visible native window (titled HWND on Windows).
metrics.note: Presentation policy, not paint; not comparable across frameworks.

metrics.oracle: Canonical page accepted with nonce/focus/visibility proof.
metrics.note: Required before any PAINT-OPPORTUNITY sample is accepted.

metrics.oracle: External nested-rAF (double requestAnimationFrame) image beacon on one monotonic clock armed before spawn. Proxy, not scanout. Never PageLoadEvent::Finished (gyldlab/keld#10). Stale/foreign/duplicate/single-rAF beacons fail closed.

implementations.macos: KEL-64 harness (feature branch, macos/harness -> macos/bench on merge)

metrics.oracle: Persistent authenticated CALL->REPLY; handshake excluded and reported separately.
metrics.note: One Windows Bun-only session recorded 2026-08-23 (KEL-99, keld 1609dbd) under windows/bench/results/ipc-rtt/: fresh-process p50 47.6 us / p90 66.3 / p99 101.6; warm-cache p50 45.9 / p90 59.3 / p99 100.5; 10,000 calls per session, handshake excluded. publication.eligible is false (1 session vs >=20 required, 10k calls vs 100k, no paired Rust arm, no block-bootstrap CIs, thermal state unverified) — diagnostics only, NOT a verdict against the <=100 us budget. macOS and Linux remain unmeasured.

metrics.oracle: Bytes validated end-to-end; copy count and transport named. 64 KiB / 1 MiB / 16 MiB inline; larger only in a future measured shm lane.
Keld-owned RSS, engine helpers, total coalition/tree, and private dirty reported separately (diagnostics block per run). Condition-based stability after ready/paint, never a fixed sleep.
metrics.note: The scored value is the Keld-owned (main) RSS; helper/total/private-dirty are per-run diagnostics so lanes are never blended.

metrics.oracle: Kill -> revoke -> fresh HELLO -> first successful call; window continuity independently observed.
Raw host / runtime / engine-in-bundle / wrapping / compressed artifact measured as separate lanes; never blended into one number.
metrics.note: Existing MEASUREMENTS.md disk tables predate this registry; new disk results use one document per lane.

metrics.oracle: Installed bytes/time; signed update size/apply/rollback outcome.
